title: Cover Sessions Project menu panel anchoring through App-level behavior
outcome: A regression test fails if the Sessions Project dropdown loses its full-panel anchor or the anchor leaks into a different control-panel scope menu.
acceptance: An App-level test opens the Sessions Project menu with realistic mocked rectangles and asserts the rendered portal uses the session scope row's horizontal bounds, including a panel width change.
A non-anchored scope menu retains its trigger width; tests assert observable geometry and interaction instead of source text or class-name pins.
